final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT m.Name AS n, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS r, COUNT(*) AS c FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM s1) SELECT s1.n, s1.r, s1.c, s1.r - s2.a FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.r > s2.a
